p1.note: Task 11: the vault world against P1 (native panel, colour truth). Each sample is the median of its boxes (x0, y0, x1, y1, px; 'without' boxes left out), or with stat top25 the median of the brightest quarter of those pixels (small glowing sprigs over dark ground). The render boxes are on the intro at the owner's desktop size: /?world=veyra&stage=intro&freeze&tier=high at 1536 x 1024 (scale 1). 'relic' is spec 7.7's rule on the pixels: the portal's 99.5th-percentile linear luminance stays below the face's; 'noClip': no white pixel (R, G, B all 250 or more) on the membrane's rim strips; 'noRed': see its rule. Run: python scripts/veyra_world.py <capture.png>.
p1.panel: docs/design/references/Veyra/native-panels/01 - Veyra Enters the Vault OS World.png

membrane body.withoutReason: The padlock is left out of both boxes. (Fix round 1: a second render box, a 40 px band right of the padlock, had no recorded reason and is removed; with it the body was (27, 130, 146), delta E 3.6, without it (24, 127, 144), delta E 2.5.)

membrane edge.capped: The edge's own colour is within 4% of the relic cap. In config units (what config.test holds below the face core's 0.810) the edge #70e6dc is 0.652, 0.782 at a full flash (x 1.2): a brighter edge colour fails the relic rule. On screen the rim's brightest quarter is about 0.43 in linear luminance against P1's 0.89 (and her face's 0.938, so P1's rim would pass the pixel relic rule): the shortfall is the membrane shader's wide edge band, the fog share and the vignette, not the colour. Reaching P1 needs an engine change to the membrane (a narrower, brighter edge, or the cap measured at rest), an owner decision.

p1.deltaEReason: Set after tuning (round 6), not before, from the spread of P1's own pixels: inside each P1 box, the median pixel lies delta E 4.8 (mid water), 5.8 (padlock), 12.4 (portal stone), 15.4 (membrane body) and 22.2 (plants, brightest quarter) from that box's median (p75 8.1 to 28.5). These are painterly regions, not the flat-shaded character samples Task 7 holds at 10. At 10, three held samples would miss (padlock 13.0, plants 10.2, portal stone 13.8 on the round 6 frame): veyra_world.py prints them, for the owner to rule on.

noRed.rule: Outside her silhouette (<capture>-mask.png dilated by herPx), the coral boxes, near-black pixels (every channel below darkBelow, dither) and the technology pendants, no pixel has R > G and R > B. All counts are printed. The pendants are left out (Task 15 fix round 1): technology logos are content in brand colours, P4 shows a red Redis orb; the rule holds for the world, not the pendants. A pixel is on a pendant when it lies within pendantPx of a pendant's centre (<capture>-pendants.json, the orb buttons' centres) and differs by more than pendantDiff in some channel from <capture>-solo.png (the same frozen frame with the pendants hidden), so world red near an orb, which both frames show, still counts.

p3.note: Task 12: the overview (pose, dome, face) against P3 (native panel, colour truth). Capture: WORLD=veyra node scripts/world-capture.mjs overview <out.png> tier=high&kitwait=90000 (the plain page at 1605 x 1485, 3x the panel, a desktop layout with the HTML panel in). Check: python scripts/check_stage.py <out.png> --world --stage overview --world-id veyra. Boxes are world units [x0, y0, x1, y1] (1 unit = 100 native px from the panel's centre; the overview frame is exactly the panel), read in the panel and in the capture brought down to the panel's size; stat top25 is the median of the brightest quarter (a thin bright rim line).
p3.deltaEReason: Set before tuning: Task 7's limit for the character's flat-shaded samples. P3's own spread inside each box (std of its channels) is printed by the report, not used to widen it.

face glow.reason: the face's colours belong to the intro's gate (P2, Milestone 1): P3 paints the same face warmer and wider-set, and one face cannot match both; printed for the owner's ruling (Task 12, decided after the first capture)

composition.note: rim: the greenest pixel along a profile ['y', x, y0, y1] (across the top) or ['x', y, x0, x1] (across a side), the same recipe on both images; P3's measured dome fits a superellipse centre (0, 0.655), half-width 1.44, half-height 0.98, power 2.2 (RMS 0.014 of the radius over 16 rim points: Task 12's report). eyes: the centroid of the pixels darker than eyeDarkBelow (every channel) in each eye's box (pupil, iris and lid line). box: the silhouette's extent from <capture>-mask.png (the dome glass and the orbs are not in it) against the arms' extent read by hand on P3's gridded 3x panel, orbs and cords left out.
